additional_metadata.trained_on: RAID train 1.15M rows (11 attacks x 53k + none 407k weak-family weighted) + 8-source external human corpus 148.6k (Wikipedia/arXiv-2021/pushshift-2012/aclImdb/RecipeNLG/booksummaries/PoetryFoundation/BBC-2006, all pre-LLM) + RAID human x4; title-grouped split, external humans train-side only
additional_metadata.method: Ensemble mean of 3 detectors: Qwen3-0.6B+LoRA x2 (v0.16 ext-human-pool variant + v0.15 full-attack variant) + ModernBERT-base+LoRA; per-domain TPR calibration; local official-distribution sim: single v0.16 0.9962, ensemble 0.9985
